Punjab Congress Reinstates Suspended MLA Amid Party Unity Efforts

The Punjab Congress has revoked the suspension of former MLA Madan Lal Jalalpur. This action comes as Pargat Singh is reportedly working to mend rifts within the party. The suspension was lifted amid speculation that Jalalpur might switch to the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).
